'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Central African Republic Civil War (2012–present)|Central African Republic Civil War]]
**[[Rwanda]] deploys what it calls a "protection force" to the [[Central African Republic]] after its [[United Nations peacekeeping|peacekeeper]]s were attacked by advancing rebel forces on the capital [[Bangui]]. The [[government of Rwanda|Rwandan]] and [[government of the Central African Republic|Central African Republic governments]] accuse former President [[François Bozizé]] of backing the rebels and plotting a [[coup]], which he denies. [[Russia]] also sends troops and heavy weaponry to support the government. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-55394042 (BBC News)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[December 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
***Rahmatullah Nikzad, head of the journalists’ union in [[Ghazni]], dies after being shot three times in the chest by unknown assailants. Nikazd is the fifth journalist to have been killed in Afghanistan in the last two months, and the seventh this year. [https://www.voanews.com/south-central-asia/prominent-journalist-killed-eastern-afghanistan (Voice of America)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Removal of Confederate monuments and memorials]]
**A [[Robert E. Lee (Valentine)|statue]] of [[Confederate States of America|Confederate]] general [[Robert E. Lee]] presented by [[Virginia]] is removed from the [[National Statuary Hall]] of the [[United States Capitol]]. It is slated to be replaced by a statue of [[civil rights in the United States|civil rights]] activist [[Barbara Rose Johns]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2020/dec/21/barbara-johns-robert-e-lee-capitol-washington (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[CARES Act]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives]] passes a [[United States dollar|$]]900 billion COVID-19 relief bill with a vote of 359-53. [https://www.businessinsider.com/stimulus-deal-passed-house-democrats-direct-checks-unemployment-mcconnell-senate-2020-12 (''Business Insider'')]
**The [[United States Senate]] passes the [[United States dollar|$]]900 billion COVID-19 relief bill with a 92–6 vote. The bill will head to [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] for his signature. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/on-small-business/senate-passes-virus-relief-sends-bill-to-trump-congress-update/2020/12/21/0ec68d76-43f6-11eb-ac2a-3ac0f2b8ceeb_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/21/covid-relief-bill-stimulus-checks-congress-republicans-democrats (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The [[Kīlauea]] [[volcano]] on [[Hawaii (island)|Hawaii]] erupts, prompting the Hawaii County Civil Defense Agency to urge residents to stay indoors. The eruption followed a series of small [[earthquake]]s. A previous eruption in [[2018 lower Puna eruption|May 2018]] destroyed hundreds of homes. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/12/21/us/kilauea-hawaii-volcano-eruption/index.html (CNN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
******[[Governor of New York|Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] announces that [[British Airways]] will require passengers to test negative for COVID-19 before arriving at the [[John F. Kennedy International Airport]] due to the new variant of the SARS-CoV-2 in the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/business/money-report/british-airways-agrees-to-require-negative-coronavirus-tests-before-new-york-flights-cuomo-says/2793409/ (WNBC-TV)]
******[[Delta Air Lines]] announces that it would require passengers travelling from New York to the United Kingdom to get a [[COVID-19 testing|COVID-19 test]] prior to departure. [https://www.usnews.com/news/us/articles/2020-12-21/delta-air-lines-requiring-covid-testing-for-ny-bound-uk-travelers (''U.S. News and World Report'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Delaware]]
*****[[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]] and incoming [[First Lady of the United States|First Lady]] [[Jill Biden|Dr. Jill Biden]] receive their first shot of the [[Pfizer]] [[BioNTech]] [[Tozinameran|vaccine]] on live television to reassure [[Americans]] of the safety of vaccines. Meanwhile, [[Vice President–elect of the United States|Vice President-elect]] [[Kamala Harris]] and incoming [[Second Gentleman of the United States|Second Gentleman]] [[Doug Emhoff]] announce that they will receive their vaccines next week. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/21/politics/bidens-coronavirus-vaccination/index.html (CNN)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois]]
*****[[Illinois]] reports 4,699 cases in the last 24 hours, the first time that the state has reported less than 6,000 cases and the lowest daily total since October 27. [https://chicago.cbslocal.com/2020/12/21/covid-19-in-illinois-state-sees-lowest-case-count-and-positivity-rate-since-the-end-of-october/ (WBBM-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington (state)]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Governor of Washington|Governor]] [[Jay Inslee]] imposes a 14-day quarantine for travelers from [[South Africa]] and the [[United Kingdom]] in an effort to prevent the spread of a mutant variant of SARS-CoV-2 in those countries. [https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/politics/new-mutation-of-coronavirus-prompts-inslee-to-issue-travel-restrictions-on-arrivals-from-united-kingdom-elsewhere/ (''The Seattle Times'')]
****The U.S. surpasses 18 million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20201222-us-covid-19-cases-surpass-18-million-according-to-johns-hopkins-university (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Premier of Ontario|Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] announces a province-wide [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] across [[Ontario]] from December 26 until January 9 in [[Northern Ontario]] and January 23 in [[Southern Ontario]] in an attempt to reduce the spread of COVID-19 in the province. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/covid-19-ontario-december-21-lockdown-orders-1.5849760 (CBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]] 
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Norway]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****The [[Government of Norway|government]] bans direct flights to and from the [[United Kingdom]] due to the emergence of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.nrk.no/norge/norge-stanser-direkteflygninger-fra-storbritannia-1.15298294 (NRK)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Russia]] announces the suspension of all flights to and from the United Kingdom for one week beginning at midnight due to the new variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/12/21/russia-to-suspend-flights-with-uk-amid-mutated-virus-fears-a72428 (''The Moscow Times'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
*****The [[Government of Spain|Spanish government]] announce the suspension of all flights from [[Spain]] to the United Kingdom beginning tomorrow, with the exception of flights for Spanish citizens residents of Spain. This comes a day after a similar suspension was announced by [[Portugal]]. [https://english.elpais.com/society/2020-12-21/spain-suspends-flights-from-the-uk-apart-from-those-carrying-spaniards-spanish-residents.html (''El Pais'' in  English)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****The [[Government of Sweden|government]] announces a ban on travel into Sweden from the [[United Kingdom]] and [[Denmark]] for one month due to the new variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://uk.news.yahoo.com/sweden-bans-travellers-britain-denmark-160430270.html (Yahoo! News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Belarus]] is expected to begin production of [[Russia]]'s [[Gam-COVID-Vac|Sputnik V]] vaccine during the first quarter of [[2021]] after it became the first foreign country to register the vaccine. [https://meduza.io/en/news/2020/12/21/belarus-becomes-first-foreign-country-to-register-russian-coronavirus-vaccine (Meduza)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]], [[Cluster 5]]
****The [[Folketing|Parliament]] passes a law that bans mink breeding until 2022. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-denmark-mink-idUSKBN28V1F1 (Reuters)]
***[[European Union response to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****The [[European Medicines Agency]] conditionally approves the [[Tozinameran|vaccine]] made by [[Pfizer]] and [[BioNTech]] for use in [[European Union]] countries. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/eu-regulator-meets-discuss-approval-covid-19-vaccine-74838532 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maharashtra]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Maharashtra]] will impose a [[curfew]] in [[Mumbai]] and other major cities from 11:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. [[Indian Standard Time|IST]] beginning tomorrow until January 5 in order to prevent the spread of the new variant of SARS-CoV-2 that was discovered in the United Kingdom. The [[Government of Maharashtra|state government]] also imposes a 14-day quarantine for anyone travelling from [[Europe]] and the [[Middle East]]. [https://www.livemint.com/news/india/maharashtra-govt-imposes-night-curfew-from-tomorrow-14-day-institutional-quarantine-for-flyers-from-europe-11608555812377.html (Livemint)]
****The [[Government of India|government]] will temporarily suspend all flights from [[India]] to the [[United Kingdom]] due to the emergence of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2. The suspension will begin tomorrow at 11:59 p.m. [[Indian Standard Time|IST]] and will last until December 31. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/india-temporarily-suspends-flights-from-uk-over-mutant-coronavirus-strain/story-BrFfSvfEa9pPhOOzPruAfL.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
****[[India]] reports 19,556 cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], the lowest in the country since July 3. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-india-cases-idUSKBN28W0DU (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 24 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 698. In addition, the country surpasses 50,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201221003300320 (Yonhap News Agency)]
****The [[Seoul Metropolitan Government]] and local governments in [[Gyeonggi Province]] and [[Incheon]] announce that they will ban gatherings of more than four people in the [[Seoul Capital Area]] from December 23 to January 3 in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/nation/2020/12/119_301227.html (''The Korea Times'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/21/south-korea-reports-record-daily-covid-19-toll-with-24-dead (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]], [[travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Secretary for Food and Health|Health Secretary]] [[Sophia Chan]] announces that [[Hong Kong]] will ban all flights to and from the [[United Kingdom]] beginning tomorrow due to the new variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/health-environment/article/3114758/hong-kong-may-ban-flights-britain-after-worsening (''South China Morning Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] surpasses 20,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://nasional.kompas.com/read/2020/12/21/16431411/update-tambah-205-pasien-covid-19-meninggal-lampaui-20000-orang (''Kompas'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Jordan]] suspends all flights to and from the United Kingdom until January 3 due to the new variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/jordan-suspends-flights-to-and-from-uk-until-jan-3-652807 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oman]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Oman]] will close all land, air, and sea borders beginning tomorrow at 1:00 a.m. local time for one week due to concerns over the new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in the United Kingdom. [https://timesofoman.com/article/oman-to-shut-down-its-borders-from-tuesday (Times of Oman)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Senate of Pakistan|Pakistan Senator]] [[Kalsoom Perveen]] dies from COVID-19. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2276808/pml-n-senator-kalsoom-parveen-succumbs-to-covid-19 (''The Express Tribune'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Singapore]] receives the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]], becoming the first country in [[Asia]] to do so. [https://www.cnet.com/google-amp/news/singapore-becomes-first-asian-country-to-receive-batches-of-pfizer-vaccine/ (CNET)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt]]
****[[Egypt]] reports 664 new cases in the past 24 hours, the highest single-day total in a months, bringing the nationwide total to 125,555 cases. [https://egyptindependent.com/egypt-reports-664-new-coronavirus-cases-29-deaths-on-sunday/ (''Egypt Independent'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
****[[Morocco]]'s [[Government of Morocco|government]] announces that they will impose a nationwide curfew from 9:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. local time and will require all cafes, shops, supermarkets, and restaurants to close at 8:00 p.m. beginning December 23. In [[Casablanca]], [[Marrakech]], [[Agadir]], and [[Tangier]], all restaurants will be closed for three weeks. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2020/12/329493/covid-19-morocco-announces-national-night-curfew-starting-wednesday/ (Morocco World News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sudan]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Sudan]] will ban all travellers from the United Kingdom, the [[Netherlands]], and [[South Africa]] beginning December 23 due to the discovery of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-sudan-idUSKBN28V2OU (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
***[[New South Wales]] detects two cases of the new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in travellers returning from the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.theaustralian.com.au/breaking-news/more-transmissible-strain-of-covid19-brought-into-australia-from-uk/news-story/38ab9a0522ab61cfa2295c09342c6b7d (''The Australian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Colombia]] announces that it will receive 1.7 million doses of the [[Tozinameran]] vaccine. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-colombia-vaccine-idUSKBN28V260 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Antarctica]]
***The first cases of COVID-19 in [[Antarctica]] are reported. 36 people test positive for the virus after spending a week at the [[Base General Bernardo O'Higgins]], in the [[Chilean Antarctic Territory]]. [https://www.infobae.com/america/agencias/2020/12/21/reportan-brote-de-coronavirus-en-base-chilena-en-la-antartida/ (Infobae)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Sudan–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Congress]] formally reinstates [[Sudan]]'s [[sovereign immunity]]. Sudan had paid the U.S. a $335 million settlement to victims of al-Qaeda attacks. The U.S. will partially pay off Sudanese bilateral debt, and its debt to the [[International Monetary Fund]] (IMF), while making another [[US$]]700 million available until September 2022 for assistance to the country. [https://www.reuters.com/article/sudan-usa-idUSKBN28W0FX (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Essex lorry deaths]]
**Two men are found guilty at [[London]]'s [[Old Bailey]] of the [[manslaughter]] of 39 [[Vietnamese people]] whom they were [[people smuggling|smuggling]] into the UK. The 39 people suffocated in a lorry during the journey across the [[North Sea]], from [[Zeebrugge]] to [[Purfleet]], in October 2019. [https://bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-55399004 (BBC News)]
*[[Halle synagogue shooting]]
**[[Government of Germany|Germany]]'s [[Federal Court of Justice]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] the perpetrator of the 2019 [[synagogue]] shooting to [[Life imprisonment in Germany#Release and imposition of preventive detention|life imprisonment with subsequent preventive detention]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-shooting-trial-idUSKBN28V1PI (Reuters)] 
*[[2020 Belarusian protests]]
**Former [[Miss Belarus]] winner [[Volha Khizhynkova]] is released from prison after 42 days for protesting against [[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]]. [https://www.dnaindia.com/world/news-miss-belarus-2008-released-after-42-days-in-prison-for-anti-government-protests-2863271 (Zee News)]
*Outgoing [[United States Attorney General]] [[William Barr]] announces charges against a bomb maker for his role in the 1988 bombing of [[Pan Am Flight 103]] near [[Lockerbie]], [[Scotland]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-55399551 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Poisoning of Alexei Navalny]]
**A report surfaces that a [[Federal Security Service]] agent allegedly involved in the plot to poison the Russian opposition leader was "duped" by Navalny into admitting that the poison was planted in Navalny's underpants. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/21/europe/russia-navalny-poisoning-underpants-ward/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2020 United States anti-lockdown protests]]
**About 300 demonstrators attempt to storm the [[Oregon State Capitol]] during a special legislative session closed to the public, but they are warded off by the [[Oregon State Police]]. The group, which called for reopening [[Oregon]] in the wake of COVID-19 mitigation measures, included members of groups such as [[Proud Boys]] and [[Patriot Prayer]]. [https://www.thedailybeast.com/heavily-armed-far-right-mob-descends-on-oregon-capitol (''The Daily Beast'')] [https://www.statesmanjournal.com/story/news/politics/2020/12/21/protesters-gather-oregon-legislature-starts-special-session/3993102001/ (''Statesman Journal'')]
*The [[Constitutional Court of Kosovo|Constitutional Court]] of [[Kosovo]] nullifies the [[Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo|parliamentary]] vote that elected [[Prime Minister of Kosovo|Prime Minister]] [[Avdullah Hoti]] in June, after discovering that one of the [[Member of parliament|members]] who voted was ineligible due to a prison sentence. The ruling mandates that Acting [[President of Kosovo|President]] [[Vjosa Osmani]] must call a new election to be held no longer than 40 days from the announcement. [https://www.rferl.org/a/kosovo-elections-hoti-parliament/31012759.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Great conjunction]]
**The planets [[Jupiter]] and [[Saturn]] appear at their closest in the sky since 1623, in an event known as a [[great conjunction]]. The closest approach will occur at 18:22 UTC, when the two planets will be one-tenth of a degree apart; they will appear to be a binary object to the naked eye. [https://www.euronews.com/2020/12/21/the-great-conjunction-jupiter-and-saturn-to-align-in-the-sky-tonight (Euronews)]
